title: Twin Prime Conjecture: Index-Value Equivalence Bridge
description: Proves the full logical equivalence between TPC (prime indices) and existence of infinitely many twin prime pairs (prime values). Key results: nthPrime_surjective, no prime between twin primes, twin_primes_are_consecutive, tpc_iff_twin_prime_pairs. 13 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms.

overview.historicalContext: The Twin Prime Conjecture (TPC) states there are infinitely many primes p with p+2 also prime. BoundedPrimeGaps.lean quantifies over prime *indices* (primeGap n = 2), while the classical formulation quantifies over prime *values*. This file proves these are equivalent.
overview.problemStatement: Prove TPC (formulated via prime indices) ↔ infinitely many twin prime pairs (formulated via prime values).
overview.proofStrategy: For p prime and p+2 prime with p ≥ 3: p is odd, p+1 is even ≥ 4, hence composite. No prime strictly between p and p+2. Therefore nthPrime(k+1) = p+2 when nthPrime(k) = p. This is the index-value bridge.
keyInsights: **No intermediate prime**: for twin primes p, p+2 with p ≥ 3, the only integer between them is p+1 which is even ≥ 4, hence composite.
**Consecutiveness**: twin primes are necessarily consecutive in the prime sequence (nthPrime(k), nthPrime(k+1)).
**Surjectivity**: every prime is nthPrime(k) for some k — this is the other direction of the bridge.

sections.title: Index-Value Bridge for Twin Prime Conjecture
sections.mathContext: TPC $\Leftrightarrow$ $\forall N$, $\exists n \geq N$, Prime $n$ and Prime $(n+2)$.

conclusion.summary: 13 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms. Complete index-value equivalence for the Twin Prime Conjecture proved.
conclusion.implications: This equivalence allows results proved in terms of prime indices (primeGap n) to be transferred to the classical statement about prime values.
openQuestions: Can the Goldbach conjecture be similarly bridged between index and value formulations?
Can the Green-Tao theorem (primes contain arithmetic progressions) be formalized?
Can the prime constellation conjectures be unified via this framework?

mainTheorems.statement: TwinPrimeConjecture ↔ ∀ N, ∃ n ≥ N, Prime n ∧ Prime (n+2)
mainTheorems.description: Full equivalence between index-formulated TPC and value-formulated twin prime conjecture.
mainTheorems.significance: Closes the logical gap between two formulations of the Twin Prime Conjecture
